queries.title: 商品目录 · 基础查询
queries.sql:
-- 示例查询：请先连接自己的数据库，再按实际表结构调整。
SELECT id, name, category, price, stock
FROM public.products
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 100;
queries.note: 只读示例。连接信息和真实查询结果不在此页面共享。

queries.title: 分类库存 · 汇总分析
queries.sql:
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS products,
       SUM(stock) AS total_stock
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_stock DESC
LIMIT 100;
queries.note: 统计每个分类的商品数量与库存。执行前核对自己的字段。
